user.title: Set up TVT Archive
user.description: Run the bridge inside Home Assistant, or connect to the optional TVT Archive app or container.

menu_options.remote: Connect to the TVT Archive app

remote.title: Connect to the TVT Archive app
remote.description: Enter the address of the TVT Archive app or container and its access token.

camera.title: Add your first camera
camera.description: The camera is tested before it is saved.

reauth_confirm.title: Update access token
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge rejected the stored access token. Print the current one with `docker exec tvt-archive tvt-archive show-token`.

hassio_confirm.title: TVT Archive app
hassio_confirm.description: Set up Home Assistant to use the TVT Archive app?

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or authenticate to the bridge
error.camera_connection_failed: The bridge could not log in to or query this camera. Check its address, port, username, and password.
error.camera_auth_failed: The camera rejected this username or password.

abort.already_configured: TVT Archive is already set up this way
abort.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not connect to the TVT Archive bridge
abort.builtin_failed: The built-in bridge could not start. Check the Home Assistant log; ffmpeg must be installed.

add_camera.title: Add camera
add_camera.description: The camera is tested before it is saved.

edit_camera_details.title: Edit camera
edit_camera_details.description: Leave the password blank to keep it.

confirm_remove.title: Remove {camera_name}?
confirm_remove.description: This removes the camera from TVT Archive. It does not delete recordings from the camera or recorder.

motion_entities.title: Motion sensors for {camera_name}
motion_entities.description: Shown on the timeline when the camera's recordings carry no motion events. Sensors from other integrations using the same address are preselected.

error.camera_connection_failed: The bridge could not log in to or query this camera. Check its address, port, username, and password.
error.camera_remove_failed: The camera could not be removed. Wait for any active playback or download to finish and try again.
error.camera_auth_failed: The camera rejected this username or password.

abort.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not connect to the TVT Archive bridge
abort.camera_not_found: The selected camera no longer exists

sd_card.title: {camera} has a problem with its SD card
sd_card.description: {camera} reports {state}, so its recordings are unavailable. Check or replace the card in the camera's settings.

ffmpeg_missing.title: TVT Archive needs ffmpeg
ffmpeg_missing.description: The built-in bridge could not find ffmpeg. Install ffmpeg on the Home Assistant host, or use the TVT Archive app instead.

camera_login.title: {camera} rejected its login
camera_login.description: The username or password for {camera} is no longer accepted. Update it under Settings > Devices & services > TVT Archive > Configure > Edit camera.

save_recording.name: Save recording
save_recording.description: Saves a recording from a camera's SD card as an MP4 in the media folder.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the recording. Leave empty to save the most recent footage.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Saved under media/tvt_archive. Defaults to the camera name and time.
